ux_intent: Validate that TV playback controls are large enough to be D-pad navigable, the progress bar communicates position and duration clearly at 10-foot viewing distance, and the overlay layout does not obscure critical video content.
figma_make_prompt:
Build a TV playback screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: Android TV, 1920x1080 base frame.
Full-screen video. A dark semi-transparent overlay (rgba 0,0,0,0.6) appears at the bottom 25 % of the frame when controls are visible.

Layout (controls overlay, bottom-aligned on the scrim):
- Title row at the top of the overlay: content title (Title Small 20sp #FFFFFF weight 600), left-aligned, 40px from the left edge.
- Progress bar: full-width minus 80px horizontal padding. Track 8dp thick — elapsed primary #6366F1, remaining #4B5563. Thumb 28dp diameter, #FFFFFF. Touch-target height 64dp. Position label left (Body Medium 18sp #FFFFFF): "12 min 05 s". Duration label right: "1 h 45 min".
- Control row: horizontal, centred, 48px gap between buttons. Five buttons, each 80x80dp touch target with 48dp icons, #FFFFFF:
  - Rewind 10s (circular arrow + "10")
  - Previous (skip back)
  - Play / Pause (96x96dp touch target, primary #6366F1 filled circle, white icon centred)
  - Next (skip forward)
  - Fast-forward 10s (circular arrow + "10")
- Close button (X) in the top-right corner of the overlay area: 80x80dp touch target.
- Focus ring: 4px solid #FFFFFF on all focusable control elements.

States:
- Playing, controls hidden: full-screen video, no overlay.
- Playing, controls visible: overlay shown. Play icon is Pause.
- Paused: controls always visible. Pause icon is Play.
- Buffering: Play/Pause icon replaced by a circular spinner (40dp). Other controls remain visible but non-interactive (60 % opacity).
- Error: overlay hidden. Centred on screen: "Playback error" (Body Large 20sp #FFFFFF) + "Retry" button (primary filled #6366F1, 240x80dp).

Behavior:
- D-pad select anywhere on screen (controls hidden) → show controls.
- D-pad left/right → move focus between control buttons.
- D-pad select on Play/Pause → toggle.
- D-pad select on Rewind 10s → seek back, position label updates.
- Controls auto-hide after 5 seconds of inactivity.

Style:
- Dark, full-bleed. Overlay rgba(0,0,0,0.6). Text #FFFFFF full opacity. Primary #6366F1. Focus ring 4px white. Auto layout.
- All text ≥ 18sp.

First step: paused state with all five control buttons visible, progress bar at 30 % with position and duration labels, and the Rewind 10s button focused (white ring visible).
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the TV playback screen is paused
When the user views the controls
Then all five transport buttons are visible with 4px white focus rings navigable by D-pad, and Play/Pause is visually the largest and most prominent

Given the progress bar is displayed
When the user views it
Then current position and total duration are shown in human-readable format and the elapsed/remaining track portions are colour-coded

Given the player is buffering
When the buffering state is rendered
Then a spinner replaces the Play/Pause icon and other controls are visibly non-interactive
manual_validation_checklist: Verify all five transport buttons are ≥ 80x80dp; Play/Pause is 96x96dp
Confirm 4px white focus ring is visible on each button when focused
Measure progress bar: thumb 28dp, track 8dp thick. Position and duration labels ≥ 18sp
Check overlay covers exactly the bottom 25 % of the frame
Verify Play/Pause is the largest button and visually dominant in the control row
Confirm all text is #FFFFFF and ≥ 18sp. Error state Retry button is ≥ 80dp touch target
